riskSignals.rationale: Official DC dinner, brunch, cocktails/wine, happy hour, and linked Toast surfaces are distinct menu presentations.
Official site also exposes National Landing menus and ordering, but those are a separate Arlington location and excluded.
Canonical Toast URL reported menu items unavailable while a rendered Toast route exposed the current brunch catalog.
Descriptions and dietary badges provide positive ingredients and limited cross-contact warnings, not a complete allergen matrix.
Frozen baseline has 21 items; current DC official/Toast catalog contains additional and changed products, and Surfside Iced Tea was not found on current DC surfaces.

findings.summary: No complete restaurant-issued allergen matrix was found. Preserve explicit positive ingredient evidence, but use unavailable for unsupported negatives and cross-contact claims except where Toast explicitly warns of fry-oil contamination.

Current catalog drift exists: current brunch/menu presentations include products absent from the frozen baseline, while Surfside Iced Tea is not present on the current DC official or Toast surfaces located.
National Landing is a separate Arlington location. Its menu and Toast URL were inventoried as linked location-specific surfaces and excluded from the Washington, DC reconciliation.

Toast explicitly marks Breakfast Fried Rice, Canto Egg + Shrimp, Canto Egg + Ham, and Garlic Chives Gao as not celiac friendly due to fry-oil cross contamination; these warnings are preserved as source-backed cross-contact signals, not converted into broad inferred may-contain arrays.

scout.summary: Bar Chinois DC identity is verified and current DC menu surfaces were found. The official dinner page exposes dinner, brunch, cocktails/wine, and happy-hour tabs; linked Toast exposes a rendered brunch/takeout catalog with repeated dietary-category presentations consolidated. The frozen 21-item baseline is mostly still present, but Surfside Iced Tea is not found on current DC surfaces and the current catalog has many additional products. Allergen evidence is incomplete: explicit positives are retained, while unsupported negatives and matrix-level claims remain unavailable. National Landing surfaces are excluded as location mismatch.
